about_me.description:
I'm a frontend developer passionate about crafting interactive, accessible, and efficient digital experiences. I work with technologies like JavaScript, React, Next.js, and GraphQL to build modern, scalable interfaces.

I specialize in performance optimization, clean code practices, and user-focused solutions. I've contributed to projects across various industries, always with a strong focus on quality, usability, and continuous learning.

experience.title: PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

API consumption and integration for querying, registering, and synchronizing operational data.
Design and implementation of interfaces for managing routes, activities, visits, and incident reports.

Integration of geolocation, NFC, and photographic evidence capture for field visit validation.
Integration of push notifications and PWA workflows with Service Workers.

Functional testing, technical documentation, and coordination of backend integrations.

Implementation of authentication with NextAuth, dual login (password/image), and role-based access control.
Construction of an analytics dashboard with ECharts, advanced filters, and indicators for engagement and competencies.

User management with role-based access control: creation, editing, enable/disable workflows, and profiles.
Bulk user upload via Excel (XLSX) and generation of downloadable PDF reports.
Construction of reusable components with Ant Design and Tailwind CSS; global state management with Zustand.
Implementation of JWT authentication and login, registration, and password recovery flows.
Unit testing with Jest, code quality with SonarQube, and technical documentation / client presentations.
Identification and resolution of design and code issues, as well as improvements to existing functionalities within an already developed project.
Development of responsive and accessible interfaces, ensuring an optimal user experience across multiple devices.
Construction of reusable and dynamic components focused on the visualization of educational outcomes.
Preparation of the project's official documentation, including technical manuals and user guides for both the team and clients.
Development of dynamic and responsive interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript for a multi-role educational platform.
Implementation of authentication, registration, and role-based access control flows with JWT and route protection.
Frontend integration with GraphQL APIs using Apollo Client, including queries, mutations, and educational content management (booklets, modules, and guides).
Development of key modules such as an educational social network (posts, comments, and likes) and dashboards with interactive visualizations (charts and maps).
Creation of reusable components and performance optimization, ensuring a consistent UX, fast load times, and smooth navigation.
Global state management with Zustand and construction of complex forms with react-hook-form (registration, user settings, and educational models).
Facilitation of access to 'pico y cédula' information during the pandemic.
Implementation of a dynamic, intuitive, and responsive interface across multiple devices.
Development of interactive components.
